title: Reuse one admitted key for each ordinary routed bucket
question: Can ordinary routing avoid repeated key frames while preserving later merge reuse and key owner lifetimes?
summary: The 96-byte-key hosted job saves 67.8 MB each of tracked reads, writes and peak temporary storage and improves every elapsed pair. The late-key handoff keeps all 64 reusable buckets with mixed elapsed results.

workloads: Eight 96-byte keys, eight one-byte keys, and a late-key handoff from 64 routed buckets.

validation.summary: Exact CSV digests, order, groups, lineage, sizes, caps, marker and cleanup. Focused owner, truncation and cancellation coverage includes a packed row surviving its originating file.

limitations: Three matched pairs per cell on one persistent bundled Chromium/WSL2 environment. Late handoff elapsed results vary by pair.
exclusions: Experimental compact spill timing, native elapsed time, physical device I/O and renderer RSS.
